# **Creating Cash In The Gap** 

A bit of a different one for you guys today. We brought it up recently around how we’re gonna do a little quick campaign. 

1\. To generate an influx of sales  
2\. To tap into a different bucket of folks in our audience 

Now all of you know our model, process, beliefs, stances on business, etc. 

Now this little 5-day jv is with someone who has the polar opposite.. 

They don’t have a powerful brand.. They don’t have a community.. They don’t create content regularly.. 

But before we dive in: a couple of notes\! 

- Nothing is changing in our model, or business.. We’re not burning anything down to do this.. 

- We’re not tweaking, or even really adding this process to our business \- we’re simply bridging the gap between folks in our audiences that want to do this & someone that we trust that’ll teach them 

- We are ONLY doing this because the trust that has been established with the creator of this program/product / process \- they’ve been in our worlds/group juice for years &  their morals align with ours 

- At the end of they day: if folks want / desire to dive down this model \- they’re not likely our peeps anyways, they’re not gonna have success with group juice, or core \- because we’ll push them to work, and get out there \- so we might as well match them with a fit for them & get paid in the process 

So here’s why this has popped so far (Not from a sales standpoint yet \- we’ll keep you posted) 

1) We’ve been hammering on message, style, angle & agenda for yearssss 

   1) Personal branding, getting on camera, doing the work, etc.. (this is the polar opposite) 

      The whole You’ve only had expensive offers for years & then roll out something low ticket & it takes off like wildfire 

2) It strokes the “easy nerve” for folks \- but from someone who’s been successfully doing it for years. Not like “they’re running a personal brand & selling the opposite.. They’re literally the \#1 affiliate on Warrior plus 

**So let’s dive in: What we’re doing, how we’re doing it.**
